import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

# Configuration
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission/"
SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")


def main():
    # Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
    os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    # Load data
    print("Loading data...")
    df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
    df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

    # Identify features and targets
    id_col = "Id"
    target_col = "Cover_Type"
    feature_cols = [c for c in df_train.columns if c not in [id_col, target_col]]

    X = df_train[feature_cols]
    y = df_train[target_col].astype(int).values
    X_test = df_test[feature_cols]
    test_ids = df_test[id_col]

    # Convert to numpy float32 to optimize memory usage
    X = X.values.astype(np.float32)
    X_test = X_test.values.astype(np.float32)

    # Remove stratify=y to avoid ValueError on rare target classes
    X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42
    )

    num_classes = len(np.unique(y))

    # Define LightGBM parameters
    params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": num_classes,
        "metric": "multi_logloss",
        "verbose": -1,
        "random_state": 42,
        "n_estimators": 1000,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 63,
        "max_depth": -1,
        "min_child_samples": 20,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "force_col_wise": True,
    }

    print("Training validation model...")
    # Train on training split only
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)

    # Evaluate on hold-out validation set (genuine hold-out estimate)
    y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
    val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred_val)
    print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy}")

    print("Retraining final model on full training data...")
    final_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
    final_model.fit(X, y)

    # Generate predictions on test set
    print("Generating predictions...")
    y_pred_test = final_model.predict(X_test)

    # Create submission DataFrame
    submission = pd.DataFrame({id_col: test_ids, target_col: y_pred_test.astype(int)})

    # Save submission
    submission.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
    print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
